spans.s: चुद् vt. 10U (pp. चोदित; pres. चोदयति-ते) 1. To send, to direct, to throw, to push on; 2. to inspire, to impel; 3. to press with a request; 4. to put forward (as an argument or objection).With परि-, 1. to push on, to send, to direct; 2. to incite, to impel.With प्र-, 1. to impel, to urge, to incite, चापलाय प्रचोदितः R.i.9; 2. to drive, to push on; 3. to direct.With सम्-, 1. to direct, to incite, to impel; 2. to throw.
